mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT 1 FROM shopion.tOrdOrderProd OP INNER JOIN shopion.tOrdOrder O ON OP.OrderNo = O.OrderNo INNER JOIN shopwizard.tCmpChnl Ch ON O.ChnlCode = Ch.ChnlCode
GROUP BY IFNULL(OP.ProdName, ''), IFNULL(OP.ItemName, '') ) g

SELECT UM.ProdName, UM.ItemName, UM.MatchSeq, UM.MatchUpriceCode, UM.Qty, U.Keywrd, U.Capa, U.Uprice, U.UnitName FROM shopwizard.tOrdUpriceMatch UM INNER JOIN shopwizard.tOrdOrderUprice U ON U.MatchUpriceCode = UM.MatchUpriceCode AND U.UseYn = 1 WHERE UM.ProdName = #{prodName} AND UM.ItemName = #{itemName} ORDER BY UM.MatchSeq
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM shopwizard.tOrdUpriceMatch WHERE ProdName = #{prodName} AND ItemName = #{itemName}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shopwizard.tOrdUpriceMatch (ProdName, ItemName, MatchSeq, MatchUpriceCode, Qty, State, Remark, RegistId, RegistName, RegistDate) VALUES (#{prodName}, #{itemName}, #{matchSeq}, #{matchUpriceCode}, #{qty}, 1, #{remark}, #{registId}, #{registName}, NOW())
